root_cause: Required used workflow-level PR concurrency, so a new exact-head run could enter pending while GitHub released the predecessor even when no content gate was blocking.
Closed historical PRs could leave queued/pending Actions runs behind because PR Janitor closed PRs but did not cancel orphaned workflow runs.
prevention: Start Required workflows without a top-level concurrency lock; fail fast when the live PR head no longer equals the classified head.
Apply cancellable concurrency only to expensive provider and delivery lanes.
On PR close and scheduled fallback, cancel only queued/pending/waiting/requested pull-request runs whose head SHA/ref is not owned by any open PR.

observed: Required entered pending in PR-scoped workflow concurrency after an exact-head refresh.
Closed historical pull-request workflow runs remained queued after their PR no longer existed.
